-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.WalkerLaws` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.fieldSet_fieldsAt.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal), smd.fieldSet S t x = smd.fieldsAt S t [] x

def smd.compare_cmpO.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal), smd.compare S t l r = smd.cmpO S t [] (some l) (some r)

def smd.cmpF_fuel.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.fuelO l r ≤ n → smd.cmpF n S t p l r = smd.cmpO S t p l r

def smd.conforms_item.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString) (vs : List smd.UVal),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.list e rel ks) →
      smd.conforms S t (smd.UVal.list vs) →
        (∀ (v : smd.UVal), v ∈ vs → smd.conforms S e v) ∧
          (rel = smd.ElemRel.associative → (∀ (v : smd.UVal), v ∈ vs → smd.itemKeyOk ks v) ∧ (smd.keysOf ks vs).Nodup)

def smd.mergeF_fuel.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Nat) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.fuelO l r ≤ n → smd.mergeF n S t l r = smd.mergeO S t l r

def smd.isTVu_isTVv.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.TypedValue) (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef)
    (x : smd.UVal), smd.isTVu tv sc S t x DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜smd.conforms S t x⌝ ⊣⊢ smd.isTVv tv sc S t x

def smd.merge_conforms.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal),
    S.WF → smd.conforms S t l → smd.conforms S t r → smd.conforms S t (smd.merge S t l r)

def smd.tw_zero_pooled.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc),
    typedPointsto w (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.toFieldSetWalker) (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ smd.twPooled w

def smd.isValO_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq : DFrac) (o : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.isValO v dq o ⊢ |==> smd.isValO v DFrac.discard o

def smd.merge_mergeO.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : smd.UVal),
    smd.merge S t l r = (smd.mergeO S t (some l) (some r)).getD smd.UVal.null

def smd.cw_zero_pooled.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc),
    typedPointsto w (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.compareWalker) (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ smd.cwPooled w

def smd.ownCmp_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp), smd.ownCmp c C ⊢ |==> smd.isComparison c C

def smd.cmpO_card.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.sizeO l < smd.smdSizeMax →
      smd.sizeO r < smd.smdSizeMax →
        smd.FSet.CardLt (smd.cmpO S t p l r).removed (2 ^ 63 - 1) ∧
          smd.FSet.CardLt (smd.cmpO S t p l r).modified (2 ^ 63 - 1) ∧
            smd.FSet.CardLt (smd.cmpO S t p l r).added (2 ^ 63 - 1)

def smd.typedPkgInit_pools.law : Prop :=
  isPkgInit pkg_id.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed ⊢ smd.typedPools

def smd.mergeO_leaf.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.leafAt S t l r = true → l.isSome = true ∨ r.isSome = true → smd.mergeO S t l r = smd.leafM l r

def smd.rw_zero_pooled.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc),
    typedPointsto w (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.reconcileWithSchemaWalker) (DFrac.own 1) ⊢
      smd.rwPooled w

def smd.outRep_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (o : Loc) (x : Option smd.UVal), smd.outRep o x ⊢ □ smd.outRep o x

def smd.isTVv_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (tv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.TypedValue) (sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef)
    (x : smd.UVal), smd.isTVv tv sc S t x ⊢ □ smd.isTVv tv sc S t x

def smd.reconOut_reconcile.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet),
    S.WF →
      match smd.reconOut S t [] false s with
      | none => smd.reconcile S t s = s
      | some N =>
        smd.reconcile S t s = (smd.FSet.filter (fun q => !smd.FSet.any (fun p => List.isPrefixOf p q) N) s).union N

def smd.reconOut_granular.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (b : Bool) (F : smd.PathSet),
    smd.reconTouch S t b F = false → smd.reconOut S t p b F = smd.reconBelow S t p F

def smd.vw_zero_pooled.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc),
    typedPointsto w (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.validatingObjectWalker) (DFrac.own 1) ⊢
      smd.vwPooled w

def smd.reconOut_scalar.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (b : Bool) (F : smd.PathSet) (s : smd.Scalar),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.scalar s) → smd.reconOut S t p b F = none

def smd.ownPath_truncate.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Path) (p : smd.Path) (pe : smd.PE),
    smd.ownPath s (p ++ [pe]) ⊢
      smd.ownPath (slice.slice s sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement (W64 0) (s.len - W64 1)) p

def smd.optU_idem.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Option smd.PathSet), smd.optU a (smd.optU a b) = smd.optU a b

def smd.mergeO_list.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t e : smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel) (ks : List GoString) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.list e rel ks) →
      smd.leafAt S t l r = false →
        smd.mergeO S t l r =
          smd.mergeListOut (smd.fuelL (smd.listItems l) (smd.listItems r)) S e ks (smd.listItems l) (smd.listItems r)

def smd.optU_assoc.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b c : Option smd.PathSet), smd.optU (smd.optU a b) c = smd.optU a (smd.optU b c)

def smd.isComparison_open.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp),
    smd.isComparison c C ⊣⊢
      ∃ r m a,
        typedPointsto c { Removed' := r, Modified' := m, Added' := a } DFrac.discard ∗
          smd.isSet r C.removed ∗ smd.isSet m C.modified ∗ smd.isSet a C.added

def smd.mergeO_some.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    S.WF → smd.confO S t l → smd.confO S t r → l.isSome = true ∨ r.isSome = true → (smd.mergeO S t l r).isSome = true

def smd.cmpO_below.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    smd.cmpO S t p l r =
      if smd.leafAt S t l r = true then smd.cmpBelow S t p l r else (smd.cmpBelow S t p l r).union (smd.nodeC p l r)

def smd.mw_zero_pooled.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Loc),
    typedPointsto w (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.typed.mergingWalker) (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ smd.mwPooled w

def smd.isComparison_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : Loc) (C : smd.Cmp), smd.isComparison c C ⊢ □ smd.isComparison c C

def smd.conforms_entry.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel)
    (kvs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) →
      smd.conforms S t (smd.UVal.map kvs) →
        ∀ (k : GoString) (v : smd.UVal), (k, v) ∈ kvs → ∃ t', smd.fieldType fs e k = some t' ∧ smd.conforms S t' v

def smd.mergeO_map.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (fs : List (GoString × smd.TypeRef)) (e : Option smd.TypeRef) (rel : smd.ElemRel)
    (l r : Option smd.UVal),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) →
      smd.leafAt S t l r = false →
        smd.mergeO S t l r =
          smd.mergeMapOut (smd.fuelM (smd.mapItems l) (smd.mapItems r)) S fs e (smd.mapItems l) (smd.mapItems r)

def smd.removeAt_scalar.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.Scalar) (R : smd.PathSet) (x : smd.UVal),
    S.find t.name = some (smd.Atom.scalar s) → smd.removeAt S t R x = x

def smd.ownPath_nil.law : Prop :=
  ⊢ smd.ownPath slice.nil []

def smd.isTV_isTVv.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p sc : Loc) (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (x : smd.UVal),
    smd.isTV p sc S t x ⊣⊢ ∃ tv, typedPointsto p tv DFrac.discard ∗ smd.isTVv tv sc S t x

def smd.fieldSet_card.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (p : smd.Path) (x : smd.UVal),
    x.size < smd.smdSizeMax → smd.FSet.CardLt (smd.fieldsAt S t p x) (2 ^ 63 - 1)

def smd.spareWalkers_nil.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (V : Type) [inst : TypedPointsto V], ⊢ smd.spareWalkers V null
